news.portal.title: The extra-class portal is taking shape
news.portal.body: The main page and navigation are in place. Registration, search and administration screens are being built by the team right now.
news.registration.title: Spring enrolment opens in two weeks
news.registration.body: Twenty-three extra classes will be offered next term, from robotics to chamber choir. The catalogue will appear here once staff publish it.
news.guide.title: How to choose an extra class
news.guide.body: You may join up to three extra classes per term. Check the weekday and room before enrolling: most courses run once a week for ninety minutes.
